overview: Chattanooga, Tennessee is a strong base for travelers who want a concise mix of landmark stops, local neighborhoods, and outdoor time. This Tier-2 guide gives you quick planning coverage with essential experiences and practical pacing. Start each day with one anchor attraction, then add a nearby activity to reduce transit time and keep your Chattanooga itinerary efficient while still feeling varied and local.
